title: A NASA Probe Flew Into the Sun's Atmosphere at 430,000 mph

scenes.text: A spacecraft flew through the Sun's atmosphere at 430,000 miles an hour.
It's the Parker Solar Probe, the fastest human-made object ever.
On December 24, 2024, it passed just 3.8 million miles above the Sun's surface.
Its heat shield is rated for temperatures up to about 2,600 degrees Fahrenheit.
NASA confirmed it survived the flyby.
It touched the Sun's atmosphere and kept working.

description:
